Olivia - Partner Eng: Quick heads-up — MedCity tried to onboard our marketplace bundle into their legacy on-prem k8s and hit two blockers: their security ops will only allow model key unwrap inside their Azure Managed HSM (no external KMS allowed), and they block egress except to internal registry + Azure PrivateLink endpoints. Install fails on bootstrap with KMS AccessDenied. Can SI + infra triage?
Ravi - SI: Reproduced in a staging cluster. Install logs: 
```nERROR: failed to fetch secret: AccessDenied
  at kms.decrypt (kms.go:122)
  Caused by: principal not allowed to unwrapKey on managedHSM
```
Ravi - SI: Also, image pulls fail because registry.redwood.dev is blocked. They only permit internal registry host and Azure endpoints over Private Link.
Diane - Solutions: Two constraints to solve: (1) HSM-only unwrap, (2) zero/limited egress. Short-term workaround: Dedicated Private deployment (customer VPC) with BYOK to their AKV via Private Endpoint. Long-term: signed marketplace artifacts + attestation flow so customers can mirror images locally. Need arch call today.
Sam - Infra: For Private/Dedicated we'll need an official allowlist of endpoints/ports. Minimal for initial run: 
- TCP 443 -> <their-registry-host> (or private mirror)
- TCP 443 -> telemetry.redwood.dev (optional/opt-in)
- UDP 123 -> NTP (optional)
If they block egress entirely we must support mirroring images into their internal registry and provide image signing + verification.
Ravi - SI: MedCity will only accept mirrors if we provide signed images + attestation that keys never left an HSM. How can our bootstrap perform unwrap using their AKV Managed HSM?
Olivia - Partner Eng: Two-prong plan: (A) Support BYOK via Azure Key Vault Private Link — create a service principal scoped to the cluster with unwrapOnly permissions; (B) provide a PKCS#11-compatible shim or sidecar so the runtime can call into AKV over Private Link and perform unwrap inside their HSM. We have an AWS CloudHSM shim prototype; adapt for AKV. Internal reference: https://go.redwood.dev/marketplace-kms (internal).
Tom - Security: Confirming feasibility. Security requirements: ACLed service principal, least-privilege (unwrap only), documented attestation that the key is non-exportable and resides in Managed HSM. Need customer to provide AKV resource ID, tenant ID, and allowed principal object IDs. Also require offline-signed image policy for highly restricted customers.
Sam - Infra: I'll open RW-OPS ticket to track image mirroring automation and private registry onboarding. For Dedicated/Private we can either host a customer-only mirror in their VPC or give them signed artifacts to import. We'll need to update our installer to support imagePullSecrets for arbitrary registries.
deploy-bot: Created ticket RW-OPS-6241 assigned to infra: "MedCity: AKV HSM + marketplace image mirror onboarding" ETA: 2 business days for initial scoping.
Diane - Solutions: Proposed immediate plan: 1) 30 min architecture sync today to capture AKV resource id and exact egress allowlist; 2) Infra to scope mirror + signing flow; 3) Security to provide service principal role template and attestation checklist. Ravi — can you collect the AKV id + registry host in your upcoming call?
Ravi - SI: On it. I have a meeting with MedCity Sec at 15:00 PT. Will return with values and any additional constraints.
Olivia - Partner Eng: Sending a calendar invite for 15:30 PT and will include a meeting notes template. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
